system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You lower your voice and let the animal see that your hands are quiet.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
One minute per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One nonhostile animal able to perceive you; one minute
Duration
Progress toward the declared behavior persists while the situation remains applicable.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Spend one minute calming a nonhostile animal that can see or hear you. State the behavior you want, such as letting a companion approach. The DA sets a progress target for a behavior the animal could plausibly accept. Roll Guile. This card gives no control over hostile or intelligent creatures.

Weak
Add 1 progress toward calming the animal.
Standard
Add 2 progress and identify an immediate cause of its distress.
Strong
Add 3 progress, identify that cause, and when this completes the target, one willing companion may approach without upsetting it.

Source: design/cards/guide-a-frightened-animal.md at bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809.
